Good place for relaxing
Feb 2023 • Couples
I recently visited Saigon Sky Bar and had a truly unforgettable experience. The view of the city from the top is absolutely breathtaking - it's easily one of the most beautiful spots in Saigon. The atmosphere was chic and stylish, and the service was impeccable. The cocktails were creative and expertly crafted, with a great variety to choose from. The bar staff was very friendly and attentive, making for a comfortable and enjoyable evening. I highly recommend visiting Saigon Sky Bar - it's a perfect place for a night out or a special occasion, and the views are truly unbeatable. A must-visit spot in Saigon

Drinks
Apr 2015
We decided to go and have an early evening cocktail at this iconic bar in the centre of the city.

The chill out music they play until the party gets started is really cool and it works with the setting. The views from here are amazing and because it is an open air bar you do feel on to of the world even through there are bars on higher floors.

As for the drinks they were slightly cheaper prices if you are to compare to other buildings around the world with the same type of vibe. This. Is expensive for Vietnam but this then makes it exclusive.
It is well worth a visit and if you do stay late which we did the party starts around 10pm where the music and vibe changes into a party atmosphere. Would defiantly recommend early evening to 9pm... That might be because of my age!!!
